title: Northbeam TechWorks Recovery: The Hours Taken for a Rebilled Line
content:
Which hours of a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job are taken for a rebilled line turns on how many attendance days the refused line carries labour for. That count is made from the labour entries standing on the job other than those booked for the day the job was completed.

**Where the line the plan refused carries labour for more than one attendance day**, the hours recorded on the job are added and the hours recorded for the day it was completed are taken off them, the outcome never falling below nothing.

**Where that line carries labour for one attendance day**, the hours recorded on the job are taken as they stand, the day the job was completed included.

**Where neither situation holds**, only the hours recorded for the day the crew was dispatched are taken.

## The three readings

| Attendance days the refused line carries labour for | The hours taken |
| --- | --- |
| two or more | the hours recorded on the job, less the hours recorded for the day it was completed |
| one | the hours recorded on the job, as they stand |
| none | only the hours recorded for the day the crew was dispatched |

The count excludes labour booked for the day the job was completed, so a job whose only labour entry is booked for the completion day carries no attendance days on the refused line at all, and the third reading governs.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The hours below are chosen for the illustration and are not those recorded on any job on file.*

**One labour entry, booked for the completion day.** No attendance day remains, and only the hours recorded for the day the crew was dispatched are taken.

**Two labour entries, one on the completion day.** A hypothetical job records 3.5 hours and 0.75 hours, the second booked for the day the job was completed. One attendance day remains, so the second reading governs and the hours recorded on the job are taken as they stand — both entries, 3.5 plus 0.75, which is 4.25 hours.

**Three labour entries, one of them on the completion day.** The job records 3.5 hours, 2.0 hours and 0.75 hours, the last booked for the day the job was completed. Two attendance days remain, so the hours taken are 3.5 plus 2.0 plus 0.75, which is 6.25, less the 0.75 of the completion day: 5.5 hours.
